thread:
alex_k: Quick heads up — PR #11001 is green from a code perspective but CI is failing on one flaky test, blocking merge. macos-integ-shard-3 is showing EncoderCacheTest.test_kv_consistency failing. link: https://ci.redwood.internal/11001

mira_p: Which shard/logs? can you paste the failing trace?

alex_k: Here's the tail from the job:
```
ERROR: EncoderCacheTest.test_kv_consistency
AssertionError: expected 12 entries but got 11
 at tests/encoder_cache_test.py:87
--- Captured stdout ---
kv put: 0..11
kv get sequence: 0..10
```

ci-bot: Build #11001 (macos-integ-shard-3) failed: 1 test failed. Rerun available: /rerun 11001 shard=3 (requested by alex_k)

jordan_r: I can kick a rerun. Do we think this is a real regression or a timing flake? We changed the KV cache eviction last week.

alex_k: I suspect timing — the change reduces prefetch window. Locally I couldn't reproduce on macos VM but saw the same failure once with dockerized runner when tests ran concurrently.

lee_t: FWIW I reproduced with `pytest -k EncoderCacheTest -n auto` and it failed after ~20 runs. Seems like a race.

sam_dev: My vote: rerun CI once. If it flakes again, gate the change behind a feature flag and open a fix ticket. We shouldn't block the release for an intermittent test.

mira_p: @alex_k please add @jordan_r and me as reviewers if you want this merged today. I'll take it after standup. Also add a test skip/flaky TODO if we decide to merge. :thumbsup:

alex_k: Added reviewers (mira_p, jordan_r). Triggering a single rerun now. (reacted :rocket:)

ci-bot: Rerun queued by jordan_r — https://ci.redwood.internal/11001/rerun/2

jordan_r: Rerun finished — all checks passed on shard-3 this time, no failures across shards. Snapshots: one small diff in encoder_snapshot.bin (offset 0x1c).

mira_p: Can you open a follow-up to update the snapshot and add a short note about the nondeterminism? prefer a separate PR for snapshot update + flaky test label so changelog is clear.

alex_k: Will do. Merging PR #11001 now (merge-by: jordan_r). I'll open #11002 to update snapshot and add a flaky test marker and an issue to track the root cause. Thanks all.

mira_p: Thanks — LGTM after snapshot PR. Please tag the follow-up with the release milestone. :white_check_mark:
